**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — RENEWAL, § 8.2–8.3.**

The renewal bargain already sits at our preferred position:
- 12-month renewal terms (no multi-year auto-renewal).
- 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window, with the opt-out deadline extended if Vendor fails to send its reminder.
- Express Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal.
- Uplift capped at the lesser of CPI-U and 3%, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

No redline proposed. Note for the file: § 7.7's liquidated-damages mechanic and § 9.4's convenience right are separate commercial terms outside this rule's scope.
